API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIDevice GroupsDevice Group Resource Get Device Groups
Device Group Resource Get Device Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/deviceGroups

Gets a list of device groups.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
includeDeviceInfo
boolean

Include or exclude device information.

Default value: false
includePseudoGroups
boolean

Include or exclude Zscaler Client Connector and Cloud Browser Isolation-related device groups.

Default value: true
includeIOTGroups
boolean

Include or exclude IoT device groups.

Default value: false
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique identifer for the device group.

name
string

The device group name.

groupType
string

The device group type.

Possible values: [ZCC_OS, NON_ZCC, CBI]

description
string

The device group's description.

osType
string

The operating system (OS).

predefined
boolean

Indicates whether this is a predefined device group. If this value is set to true, the group is predefined.

deviceCount
int32

The number of devices within the group.

]
